Stacked Deck.name: Stacked Deck
Stacked Deck.description: The user stores copies instead of replacing them. For the rest of the scene they hold a few copied Quirks at once and switch between them freely as part of any action, raising a copied wall one moment and sprinting on a copied speed Quirk the next. Each copy still works at a beginner's level, and only a single copy runs at a time. Strain: heavy.
